code: import axios from"axios";export const API_SERVER_HOST='http://localhost:8080';const prefix="".concat(API_SERVER_HOST,"/api/manager");export const getOne=async userId=>{const res=await axios.get("".concat(prefix,"/").concat(userId));return res.data;};export const getList=async pageParam=>{const{page,size}=pageParam;const res=await axios.get("".concat(prefix,"/list"),{params:{page:page,size:size}});return res.data;};
